tables below describe the success arm, and tool execution failures carry

Regenerate after changing tool signatures or contracts:

```bash
python scripts/generate_tool_reference.py
```

## memory_store

Store a memory episode in the episodic buffer. Always store memories when you learn something new about the user, solve a problem, discover a preference, or encounter something surprising. Write content as a self-contained note that future-you can understand without context. Include both the problem AND solution for solution-type memories. Do NOT store trivial exchanges like greetings.

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `string` | yes | — | The text content to store. Include relevant context. |
| `content_type` | `string` | no | `'exchange'` | Category of the memory. 'exchange' for conversation, 'fact' for learned info, 'solution' for problem+fix (use Problem:/Fix: lines, structured JSON type=solution, or path anchors — see docs/FAST_PATH_EPISODES.md), 'preference' for user preference, 'procedure' for repeatable workflows (see docs/FAST_PATH_EPISODES.md). Post-consolidation 'strategy' records use structured JSON with any ingest content_type. |
| `tags` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Optional topic tags for organization (e.g., ['python', 'debugging']). |
| `surprise` | `number` | no | `0.5` | How novel this is, 0.0 (routine) to 1.0 (very surprising). |
| `scope` | `object \| string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional scope input. Use a canonical scope object, or pass a string shorthand that auto-maps to project scope (path-like values -> project.root_uri, otherwise -> project.slug). |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `enum('stored', 'duplicate_detected', 'backend_unavailable', 'write_denied')` | yes | Outcome: stored, duplicate_detected, backend_unavailable or write_denied. |
| `id` | `string \| null` | yes | Episode id, null when nothing was written. |
| `content_type` | `string \| null` | yes | Content type actually stored. |
| `tags` | `string[]` | yes | Tags stored with the episode. |
| `existing_id` | `string \| null` | yes | Id of the near-duplicate episode, if detected. |
| `similarity` | `number \| null` | yes | Similarity score of the detected duplicate. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | yes | Additional human-readable detail, if any. |
| `shape_warnings` | `string[]` | yes | Non-blocking data quality warnings. |

## memory_recall

Retrieve relevant memories by semantic similarity. Returns episodes, knowledge documents, and individual knowledge records (facts, solutions, preferences, procedures, strategies). Call this at the start of every new conversation and when context about the user's setup or preferences would improve your response. This is your persistent memory.

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string` | yes | — | Natural language description of what to recall. |
| `n_results` | `integer` | no | `10` | Maximum number of episode results. |
| `include_knowledge` | `boolean` | no | `true` | Whether to include consolidated knowledge documents. |
| `content_types` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Filter to specific content types (e.g. ['solution', 'fact']). |
| `tags` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Filter to episodes with at least one matching tag. |
| `after` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Only episodes created after this ISO date (e.g. '2025-01-01'). |
| `before` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Only episodes created before this ISO date. |
| `include_expired` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Include temporally expired knowledge records. Default False. |
| `as_of` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | ISO datetime for temporal belief queries. Returns knowledge state at that point in time, including records that have since been superseded (e.g. '2025-06-15T00:00:00+00:00'). |
| `entity` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional file path, module, or subject token to boost entity-linked memories (e.g. 'context_assembler.py' or 'memory_status'). |
| `hypothesis_competition` | `boolean` | no | `false` | When true, include expired or challenged contradicting partner claims as competing hypotheses with lowered ranking. |
| `scope` | `object \| string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional scope input. Use a canonical scope object, or pass a string shorthand that auto-maps to project scope (path-like values -> project.root_uri, otherwise -> project.slug). |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episodes` | `object[]` | yes | Matching episodes, best score first. |
| `knowledge` | `object[]` | yes | Matching consolidated knowledge topics. |
| `records` | `object[]` | yes | Matching knowledge records. |
| `claims` | `object[]` | yes | Matching claims from the claim graph. |
| `total_episodes` | `integer` | yes | Number of returned episodes. |
| `total_knowledge_topics` | `integer` | yes | Number of returned knowledge topics. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | yes | Notes about the query, e.g. fallbacks applied. |
| `warnings` | `string[]` | yes | Degradation warnings, empty on the fast path. |
| `entity_resolution` | `object \| null` | no | Entity linking details when the resolver ran. |

## memory_remember

Save something to memory using plain language. Prefer this over memory_store when the simple kind vocabulary is enough; memory_store is the one that takes an explicit content_type. Use kind=fix for debugging solutions (problem + what worked).

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `string` | yes | — | What to remember — include problem and fix for kind=fix. |
| `kind` | `string` | no | `'note'` | note=general, fix=solution, fact=fact, preference=user preference. |
| `tags` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Optional topic tags. |
| `scope` | `object \| string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional scope input. Use a canonical scope object, or pass a string shorthand that auto-maps to project scope (path-like values -> project.root_uri, otherwise -> project.slug). |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `enum('stored', 'duplicate_detected', 'backend_unavailable', 'write_denied')` | yes | Outcome: stored, duplicate_detected, backend_unavailable or write_denied. |
| `id` | `string \| null` | yes | Episode id, null when nothing was written. |
| `content_type` | `string \| null` | yes | Content type actually stored. |
| `tags` | `string[]` | yes | Tags stored with the episode. |
| `existing_id` | `string \| null` | yes | Id of the near-duplicate episode, if detected. |
| `similarity` | `number \| null` | yes | Similarity score of the detected duplicate. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | yes | Additional human-readable detail, if any. |
| `shape_warnings` | `string[]` | yes | Non-blocking data quality warnings. |

## memory_ask

Search memory with a plain-language question. Returns a compact summary of matching episodes, records, claims, and topics. Call at conversation start (or use memory_recall when hooks require it). Prefer this over memory_recall for everyday retrieval.

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string` | yes | — | Natural-language question about prior work or fixes. |
| `n_results` | `integer` | no | `8` | Maximum matches per section (default 8). |
| `scope` | `object \| string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional scope input. Use a canonical scope object, or pass a string shorthand that auto-maps to project scope (path-like values -> project.root_uri, otherwise -> project.slug). |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episodes` | `object[]` | yes | Episode previews with id, kind and score. |
| `knowledge` | `object[]` | yes | Knowledge topic previews. |
| `records` | `object[]` | yes | Matching knowledge records. |
| `claims` | `object[]` | yes | Matching claims. |
| `total_episodes` | `integer` | yes | Number of returned episodes. |
| `query` | `string` | yes | Normalized query that was executed. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | yes | Notes about the query, if any. |
| `warnings` | `string[]` | yes | Degradation warnings, empty on the fast path. |

## memory_search

Keyword/metadata search over episodes. Works without embedding backend. Unlike memory_recall (semantic similarity), this does plain text matching. Use when the embedding backend is down, or for exact substring searches.

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Text substring to search for in episode content (case-insensitive). |
| `content_types` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Filter to specific content types. |
| `tags` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Filter to episodes with at least one matching tag. |
| `after` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Only episodes created after this ISO date (e.g. '2025-01-01'). |
| `before` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Only episodes created before this ISO date. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | `20` | Maximum results to return. |
| `scope` | `object \| string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional scope input. Use a canonical scope object, or pass a string shorthand that auto-maps to project scope (path-like values -> project.root_uri, otherwise -> project.slug). |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episodes` | `object[]` | yes | Matching episodes, newest first. |
| `total_matches` | `integer` | yes | Number of returned episodes. |
| `query` | `string \| null` | yes | The keyword query, null when browsing by filters. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | yes | Additional notes, e.g. when nothing matched. |

## memory_outcome_record

Record whether a strategy/action worked. Outcome observations are durable evidence for trust scoring and can be linked to claim/record/episode provenance, code anchors, and issue/PR identifiers.

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action_summary` | `string` | yes | — | Concise description of the attempted strategy or action. |
| `outcome_type` | `string` | yes | — | Outcome classification for this observation. |
| `source_claim_ids` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Claim IDs this outcome is linked to. |
| `source_record_ids` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Knowledge record IDs this outcome is linked to. |
| `source_episode_ids` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Episode IDs this outcome is linked to. |
| `code_anchors` | `record<string, string>[] \| null` | no | `null` | Optional code anchors associated with the outcome. |
| `issue_ids` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Optional issue identifiers associated with the outcome. |
| `pr_ids` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Optional pull request identifiers associated with the outcome. |
| `action_key` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional stable strategy key. Auto-derived when omitted. |
| `summary` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional short human summary of the observed outcome. |
| `details` | `object \| string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional structured details payload for this outcome. |
| `confidence` | `number` | no | `0.8` | Confidence in this observation. |
| `provenance` | `object \| string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional provenance metadata (agent/tool/run identifiers, etc.). |
| `observed_at` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional ISO datetime when the outcome was observed. |
| `scope` | `object \| string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional scope input. Use a canonical scope object, or pass a string shorthand that auto-maps to project scope (path-like values -> project.root_uri, otherwise -> project.slug). |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `enum('recorded', 'write_denied')` | yes | Outcome: recorded or write_denied. |
| `id` | `string \| null` | yes | Id of the created outcome row, if recorded. |
| `action_key` | `string \| null` | yes | Deduplication key for the action, if provided. |
| `outcome_type` | `string \| null` | yes | Classified outcome type, if resolved. |
| `observed_at` | `string \| null` | yes | Observation timestamp, null when defaulted. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | yes | Additional human-readable detail, if any. |

## memory_detect_drift

Detect code drift by checking changed files and challenge impacted claims. Use after substantial file edits.

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base_ref` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional git base ref for comparison (e.g. 'origin/main'). |
| `repo_path` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional repository path (defaults to current working directory). |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked_anchors` | `DriftAnchorOutput[]` | yes | Anchors that were scanned for changes. |
| `impacted_claim_ids` | `string[]` | yes | Claims whose anchors changed. |
| `challenged_claim_ids` | `string[]` | yes | Claims moved to challenged status. |
| `impacts` | `DriftClaimImpactOutput[]` | yes | Per-claim status transitions caused by the drift. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | no | Present on degraded runs: explains timeouts or fallback scans. |
| `error` | `string \| null` | no | Present when the result is a failure, not a successful empty scan: carries the same text as the isError content block, so a client validating against the error arm of this schema can tell a timeout from an empty result. |

## memory_status

Show memory system statistics, including trust posture, claim coverage, provenance coverage, drift-watch pressure, episode counts, backend info, and fast-path consolidation metrics (fast_path_hits / llm_fallbacks from the last run).

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lightweight` | `boolean \| null` | no | `null` | When true, skip markdown consistency scans and return a cached snapshot when available (faster for routine checks). |
| `scope` | `object \| string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional scope input. Use a canonical scope object, or pass a string shorthand that auto-maps to project scope (path-like values -> project.root_uri, otherwise -> project.slug). |
| `global_scope` | `boolean` | no | `false` | When true, return corpus-wide audit stats ignoring resolved default scope. Default false — audit reads use the same resolved scope as recall/browse. |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episodic_buffer` | `EpisodicBufferOutput \| null` | yes | Episode table counters. |
| `knowledge_base` | `KnowledgeBaseOutput \| null` | yes | Topic and record counters. |
| `last_consolidation` | `object \| null` | yes | Summary of the most recent consolidation run, null before the first run. |
| `embedding_backend` | `string` | yes | Configured embedding backend name. |
| `embedding_model` | `string` | yes | Configured embedding model name. |
| `faiss_index_size` | `integer` | yes | Vectors currently in the FAISS index. |
| `faiss_tombstones` | `integer` | yes | Tombstoned vectors awaiting compaction. |
| `db_size_mb` | `number` | yes | SQLite database size in megabytes. |
| `version` | `string` | yes | Package version of consolidation-memory. |
| `health` | `HealthOutput \| null` | yes | Health assessment, null when unavailable. |
| `consolidation_metrics` | `object[]` | yes | Recent consolidation metric rows. |
| `consolidation_quality` | `object \| null` | yes | Aggregate quality stats: runs_analyzed, success_rate, avg_confidence, rates. |
| `fast_path_hits` | `integer` | yes | Consolidations answered without an LLM call. |
| `llm_fallbacks` | `integer` | yes | Consolidations that fell back to the LLM. |
| `recent_activity` | `object[]` | yes | Recent activity rows. |
| `utility_scheduler` | `object \| null` | yes | Utility scheduling state: score, weights, signals, next_due_at, last trigger. |
| `knowledge_consistency` | `object \| null` | yes | Markdown consistency scan summary for the knowledge base. |
| `scaling` | `object \| null` | yes | Scaling/backpressure counters. |
| `trust_profile` | `object \| null` | yes | Trust and ACL profile snapshot. |

## memory_compact

Compact the FAISS index by removing tombstoned vectors. Call when memory_status shows high tombstone count or ratio.

### Input

Takes no arguments.

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `enum('compacted', 'no_tombstones')` | yes | Outcome: compacted or no_tombstones. |
| `tombstones_removed` | `integer` | yes | Tombstoned vectors removed. |
| `index_size` | `integer` | yes | Vectors remaining in the index. |

## memory_consolidate

Manually trigger a consolidation run. Clusters unconsolidated episodes, synthesizes knowledge, prunes old episodes, and compacts FAISS. Can take several minutes.

### Input

Takes no arguments.

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `run_id` | `string \| null` | no | Identifier of the consolidation run. |
| `timestamp` | `string \| null` | no | Run start time (ISO 8601). |
| `episodes_loaded` | `integer \| null` | no | Episodes read for the run. |
| `episodes_with_vectors` | `integer \| null` | no | Episodes that produced embeddings. |
| `clusters_total` | `integer \| null` | no | Clusters formed. |
| `clusters_valid` | `integer \| null` | no | Clusters that passed checks. |
| `clusters_failed` | `integer \| null` | no | Clusters rejected by checks. |
| `topics_created` | `integer \| null` | no | New topics written. |
| `topics_updated` | `integer \| null` | no | Existing topics updated. |
| `episodes_pruned` | `integer \| null` | no | Episodes pruned by decay. |
| `surprise_adjusted` | `integer \| null` | no | Episodes whose surprise score was adjusted. |
| `api_calls` | `integer \| null` | no | LLM API calls spent. |
| `fast_path_hits` | `integer \| null` | no | Clusters answered without an LLM call. |
| `llm_fallbacks` | `integer \| null` | no | Clusters that used the LLM. |
| `failed_episode_ids` | `string[] \| null` | no | Episodes whose processing failed. |
| `failure_linked_episodes_loaded` | `integer \| null` | no | Episodes pulled in to prioritize known failures. |
| `clusters_prioritized_by_failures` | `integer \| null` | no | Clusters reprioritized because of linked failures. |
| `status` | `string \| null` | no | Early-exit state, e.g. already_running or error. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | no | Explanation for early exits. |
| `episodes` | `integer \| null` | no | Episode count reported by an early exit. |

## memory_consolidation_log

Show recent consolidation activity as a human-readable changelog. Returns summaries of recent runs: topics created/updated, contradictions detected, episodes pruned.

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `last_n` | `integer` | no | `5` | Number of recent runs to show (1-20, default 5). |
| `scope` | `object \| string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional scope input. Use a canonical scope object, or pass a string shorthand that auto-maps to project scope (path-like values -> project.root_uri, otherwise -> project.slug). |
| `global_scope` | `boolean` | no | `false` | When true, return corpus-wide audit stats ignoring resolved default scope. Default false — audit reads use the same resolved scope as recall/browse. |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entries` | `object[]` | yes | Changelog rows, newest first. |
| `total` | `integer` | yes | Number of returned entries. |
| `message` | `string` | yes | Notes when no entries are available. |

## memory_decay_report

Show what would be forgotten if pruning ran right now. Reports prunable episodes, low-confidence records, and protected episode counts. Does NOT actually delete anything.

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scope` | `object \| string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional scope input. Use a canonical scope object, or pass a string shorthand that auto-maps to project scope (path-like values -> project.root_uri, otherwise -> project.slug). |
| `global_scope` | `boolean` | no | `false` | When true, return corpus-wide audit stats ignoring resolved default scope. Default false — audit reads use the same resolved scope as recall/browse. |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prunable_episodes` | `integer` | yes | Episodes eligible for decay pruning. |
| `low_confidence_records` | `integer` | yes | Records below the confidence threshold. |
| `protected_episodes` | `integer` | yes | Episodes marked immune to pruning. |
| `details` | `object` | yes | Policy settings and candidate ids: prune_after_days, decay_policies, lists. |

## memory_hygiene_scan

Read-only corpus hygiene report: noisy episode candidates, orphaned active claims, and stale episode sources. Use before batch cleanup.

### Input

Takes no arguments.

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `string` | yes | Scan outcome, e.g. ok. |
| `episodes` | `object` | yes | Episode noise analysis: total_active, per-type counts, recommended_cleanup_ids, would_remain. |
| `orphaned_claims` | `object` | yes | Claims without live provenance: count, ids, samples. |
| `stale_episode_sources` | `object` | yes | Episode source rows that reference missing episodes. |

## memory_hygiene_apply

Apply corpus hygiene: forget selected or recommended noisy episodes and optionally expire orphaned claims. Irreversible unless dry_run=true.

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episode_ids` | `string[] \| null` | no | `null` | Explicit episode UUIDs to forget. |
| `use_recommended` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Forget all episodes flagged by the latest hygiene scan (temp/test, exchange, noise journal). |
| `expire_orphans` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Expire active claims that lost all provenance. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Preview actions without mutating the corpus. |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `enum('dry_run', 'applied')` | yes | Outcome: dry_run (preview, corpus untouched) or applied (cleanup committed). |
| `episode_targets` | `integer` | yes | Episodes selected for cleanup. |
| `episode_ids` | `string[]` | yes | Ids of the selected episodes. |
| `forgotten` | `integer` | yes | Episodes actually forgotten; 0 for a dry run. |
| `not_found` | `integer` | yes | Selected episode ids that were already gone; 0 for a dry run. |
| `expire_orphans` | `boolean` | yes | Whether orphaned claims were expired. |
| `orphan_repair` | `object \| null` | yes | Orphan repair summary, null when not requested. |

## memory_policy_list

List persisted namespace/project access policies and ACL bindings. Use to inspect who can read or write memory in self-hosted deployments. Like scope discovery, this listing is deployment-wide: it is NOT filtered by read_visibility or the caller's scope, so it names every persisted binding, including principals the caller cannot read into.

### Input

Takes no arguments.

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `string` | yes | Outcome, e.g. ok. |
| `count` | `integer` | yes | Number of returned bindings. |
| `policies` | `object[]` | yes | Policy/ACL binding rows. |

## memory_scope_list

Discover which scopes exist: lists every scope that has stored data, with per-table usage counts and a canonical scope envelope you can pass back as the scope argument of other tools. Counts cover live rows only. This listing is deployment-wide: it is a topology audit, intentionally NOT filtered by read_visibility, policy or the caller's scope, so it names every scope that holds data. No content is read through it. Keep the MCP subprocess off untrusted multi-tenant deployments without OS-level isolation.

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | `100` | Maximum number of scopes to return (1-1000). |
| `offset` | `integer` | no | `0` | 0-based offset into the ordered scope list for page iteration; combine with limit. |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scopes` | `ScopeUsageEntry[]` | yes | Discovered scopes, most recently used first. |
| `total` | `integer` | yes | Total number of discovered scopes before limiting. |
| `offset` | `integer` | yes | 0-based offset this window starts at. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | yes | Set when the window does not cover every scope; explains how to page. |

## memory_policy_grant

Create or update a persisted ACL binding for a principal. Omitted namespace or project selectors act as wildcards. Provide at least one of write_mode or read_visibility.

### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `principal_type` | `string` | yes | — | Principal type (e.g. app_client, agent_name). |
| `principal_key` | `string` | yes | — | Principal key (e.g. python_sdk:legacy_client). |
| `namespace` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Namespace slug selector (wildcard when omitted). |
| `project` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Project slug selector (wildcard when omitted). |
| `write_mode` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Write policy for the principal. |
| `read_visibility` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Read visibility policy for the principal. |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `string` | yes | Outcome, e.g. granted. |
| `policy_id` | `string` | yes | Id of the policy row. |
| `principal_id` | `string` | yes | Id of the principal row. |
| `acl_entry_id` | `string` | yes | Id of the created ACL binding. |
| `namespace` | `string \| null` | yes | Namespace scope of the binding, if any. |
| `project` | `string \| null` | yes | Project scope of the binding, if any. |
| `principal_type` | `string` | yes | Principal kind the binding applies to. |
| `principal_key` | `string` | yes | Concrete principal identifier. |
| `write_mode` | `string \| null` | yes | Granted write mode, if any. |
| `read_visibility` | `string \| null` | yes | Granted read visibility, if any. |
